column1: # The runtime logins of the Cloud database, as data: who they are, what each may do on which table, and their
# server-side deadlines. deploy/sql/harden-runtime-roles.sql writes these same rows in its own @rows block; this
# file states them a second time, independently, and deploy/test/runtime-roles.pg.test.ts holds the catalog the
# script leaves against it. Tab-separated: kind, role, subject, value. A value of "-" is "nothing".
# verbs with subject * is the rule for every table of schema public; a named subject narrows it for that table.
# A table named staff_* that has no row here is refused by the script until it is named.
# schema rows are the schemas a login may use; where a host keeps the search extensions (pg_trgm, btree_gin) in a
# schema of their own, the script adds that one by itself. deadline values are milliseconds.
